is_anopheles.evidence: The study uses the Anopheles gambiae (s.s.) Muleba-Kis strain.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports phenotypic resistance (mortality rates) following laboratory selection but does not report any genotype data for insecticide-resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data (RR/RS/SS counts or allele frequencies) are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses a laboratory-maintained strain (Muleba-Kis) established in 2012, not field-caught mosquitoes.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting laboratory selection experiments.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted at the Kilimanjaro Christian Medical University College, Tanzania.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports experiments conducted between 2023 and 2024.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new laboratory selection study.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data are reported in the paper or supplementary materials.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the phenotypic resistance of the laboratory-maintained Anopheles gambiae (s.s.) Muleba-Kis strain to chlorfenapyr, clothianidin, and alpha-cypermethrin after multiple generations of sub-lethal selection. It does not report any molecular marker genotyping.
exclusion_reasons: african_field_population: Study uses a laboratory colony, not field-collected mosquitoes.
